description: Every provision whose text on date_b differs from its text on date_a, in every jurisdiction or one, with the laws that took effect after date_a, up to and including date_b.

jurisdiction.description: Optional jurisdiction: a country by its name in English or its own language ("germany", "Deutschland", "UK") or its ISO code ("de"), or a path prefix, for example "germany", "united-states/federal" or "united-kingdom/uk/legislation/uksi".

kind.description: laws (default; "law" is read the same): law only. judgments: court decisions (case law) only. all: both. A jurisdiction that names case law (a path ending in /caselaw) reads it too.

name: changes_between
title: Changes between
